description: In a dense linear order without endpoints, \((\exists x\;(a<x\land x<b\land c<d))\leftrightarrow(a<b\land c<d)\), and \((\exists x\;(a<x\land x<b\land x=c))\leftrightarrow(a<c\land c<b)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.QuantifierElimination.order_examples.{u} {M : Type u} [LinearOrder M] [DenselyOrdered M] [NoMinOrder M]
  [NoMaxOrder M] [Nonempty M] (a b c d : M) :
  ((∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ c < d) ↔ a < b ∧ c < d) ∧ ((∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ x = c) ↔ a < c ∧ c < b)
